basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Project Manager and Senoir Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has released the official Project Manager and Senior Project Assistant Notification 2026 at https://home.iitd.ac.in/. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the IIT Delhi Project Manager and Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026. Candidates with a Master's Degree (preferably MCA) or a Post Graduate Degree with at least 55% marks are eligible to apply. The application process is currently open, and the last date to submit the application by email is 03 August 2026. The official notification PDF and application details are available on

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree preferably MCA with at least 55% marks, Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks
qualification.details: Project Manager: Master's Degree preferably MCA with at least 55% marks from a government recognized institute/university. Minimum 12 years of experience in office management at educational institute out of which at least 5 years at the level of Senior Assistant. Proficiency in various tools for office admin including MS-Office, EOffice, ERP, Systems etc., Web site, experience of admission procedure at the institute, organizing meeting, events, office file record, etc. Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.): Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks and 12 years of work experience with at least 5 years experience in the actual conduct of meetings/examinations and/or adequate experience of supervisory work at Jr. Superintendent level in a Govt. office or in an educational institution. Should know of Office Procedures, rules& regulations generally operative in Govt. office or in Educational Institutions, including experience in Store & Purchase procurement through GEM, Tender, etc.

salary_details.details: Project Manager: Rs. 64260 - 831840/- p.m. plus HRA @30% Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.): Rs. 47790 - 62350/- p.m. plus HRA @30%

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 03-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 is August 3, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Manager and one for Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.), totaling two vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: A Master's Degree preferably MCA with at least 55% marks or a Post Graduate Degree with 55% marks is required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Manager post ranges from Rs. 64,260 to Rs. 83,1840 per month, plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply by sending their complete application via email.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Delhi offer age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of IIT Delhi for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is http://ird.iitd.ac.in.
